reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original paragraph with no comment, which is exactly what a compliant finding should look like — no negotiation ask is raised.

The rule's preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; the document contains no non-solicit, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant, so absence is full compliance rather than a gap, and the cited p0066 (independent contractors) imposes no hiring restriction on us.

The failed deterministic sub-checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure, not substantive shortfalls; treating them as heuristics rather than verdicts, they do not undermine the finding.

Rationale is accurate and well-evidenced (searches for solicit/induce/hire/employ surface only indemnity, confidentiality, data-security and warranty language), and it correctly records the fallback the team would hold to if a non-solicit were introduced.
